name: Ryakudatsusha no In'en
source: A back story of Roy, the main character of Ryuukishi Bloody † Saga, depicting his life at early stage. Having been born in a loving family in a small village, at some point the village got attacked and burned to the ashes by a group of villains, who killed his father, raped his family and enslaved him so that he'd take care of their growing-up daughter.. and their growing-up lust up to murderous extent.
translation:
这是《Ryuukishi Bloody † Saga》主角罗伊早年人生的外传。

罗伊出生在一个充满爱的家庭，住在宁静的小村庄里。然而某天，一群恶徒袭击村庄，将它烧成灰烬，杀死他的父亲，强奸并奴役他的家人，还把罗伊留下照顾他们年幼的女儿……随着女孩的欲望不断增长，事态最终发展到杀人地步。
